purpose: Test repeatability of frozen transferable visual relationships on a materially different unseen process without source-image conditioning.

future_copy.chinese_support: 鲜叶入作 · 手工成茶

subject_truth: Fresh-leaf sorting, spreading/wilting, rolling/twisting and screening with credible fresh, wilted and rolled leaf states plus bamboo trays, cloth and work surfaces.

capsule_rules: high-information tactile process mass versus real low-frequency quiet region
quiet region emerges from staging, depth, light and material

stop_rule: Wrong subject, wrong aspect, visible text or collage, active cooking, or missing credible tea-process evidence is TECHNICAL_INVALID and stops the round.
